name: Beta Scientist
flavorText: You will stand under a problem for ten minutes narrating the exact sequence before you've touched a single hold. Movement is just applied physics, and you intend to solve it before you commit.
villainLine: They just jump at it with zero plan. It offends you on a spiritual level.
partnerLine: You map out the beta, they supply the raw power to actually execute it — a perfect division of labor.
